title: PfSMARRTer: Plasmodium falciparum Antimalarial Resistance Testing
author: Infectious Disease Epidemiology and Ecology Lab
materials: Combine the master mix and sample DNA, seal caps/strips/plates, and place the reaction in a thermocycler using the following conditions:
All reagents, PCR master mix, primer pools, and samples should be held in freezer blocks (tube or 96-well) unless stated otherwise.
Calculate the amount of reagents needed with a 10% excess to account for pipette loss.
Program thermocycler with the following conditions for 8-12 cycles.
Aspirate the clear supernatant and discard.
Allow the mixture to incubate for 00:05:00 .

steps.title: Prepare Primer Working Solutions
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 µM stock primers to 10 µM working solutions for each forward and reverse primer.

steps.title: Create Primer Pools
steps.instruction: Prepare two primer pools (Pool A and Pool B) by mixing all forward and reverse primers in the specified ratios.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR master mix for both pools A and B, calculating reagents with a 10% excess to account for pipette loss.

substeps.instruction: Adjust template DNA volume by changing the amount of PCR grade water (total volume of water and DNA must be 10 µL).

steps.title: Label and Execute PCR
steps.instruction: Label PCR reactions to identify the sample and the primer pool (A or B) being used.

steps.title: Purify PCR Products with Speed-Beads
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR products using Speed-Beads and ethanol washes.

substeps.instruction: Vortex Speed-Beads thoroughly and add 50 µL to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Place plate on a 96-well magnetic block for 2-3 minutes until the solution clears.
Aspirate and discard the clear supernatant using P200 tips.
Dispense 165 µL 80% Ethanol into each well with P200 tips, incubate for 30 seconds, then aspirate.
Aspirate final ethanol drops with P20 pipette tips and allow bead pellets to dry for 30-60 seconds.
Remove plate from magnet.

steps.title: Verify Amplification
steps.instruction: Ensure amplified DNA was not lost and fragments are the correct size.

substeps.instruction: Spot-quantify three samples using Qubit dsDNA HS reagent according to manufacturer instructions.
If needed, run purified products on a fragment analyzer (e.g., TapeStation) to verify fragments are approx. 150-400bp.

steps.title: Elute and Pool Amplicons
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA and combine the two primer pool reactions.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 25 µL of 10mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 or molecular grade water onto each bead pellet and mix by pipetting to resuspend.
Cover plate with foil seal and centrifuge briefly to collect product at the bottom.
Combine the entire Pool A and Pool B PCR reaction volumes into a single well of a 96-well LoBind PCR plate to create the final multiplex amplicon pool.

steps.title: Prepare UDI Indexing Plate
steps.instruction: Generate Unique Dual Index (UDI) plates with a final concentration of 10 µM.

substeps.instruction: Mix i5 primers across all columns and i7 primers across all rows of a LoBind DNA plate using a multichannel pipette.
Thaw the Pre-Combined UDI 96-well plate.

steps.title: Perform Indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Perform the indexing PCR using KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix 2X.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Master Mix: Combine 12.5 µL KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix 2X and 4.5 µL molecular grade water (17.0 µL total) per reaction.
Aliquot 17.0 µL Master Mix into each well of the UDI plate using a multichannel pipettor (reverse pipetting recommended).
Spin UDI plate to remove liquid from the sealing foil, then carefully remove the foil.
Add 2.5 µL of the appropriate UDI to each well.
Add 5.0 µL of Combined and Purified PfSMARRTer amplicons and gently mix by pipetting (Total volume: 24.5 µL).

steps.title: Purify Indexing Libraries
steps.instruction: Purify the resulting libraries using Speed-Beads.

substeps.instruction: Bring Speed-Beads to room temperature (30 minutes) and vortex thoroughly.
Mix fresh 80% Ethanol (200 proof ethanol and molecular grade water).
Combine libraries with Speed-Beads at a 1:1 ratio (24.5 µL), incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Spin plate at 3000 rpm for 1 minute, then place on a plate magnet for 2-3 minutes.
Dispense 80% Ethanol (volume > 80 µL) into wells, incubate for 30 seconds, and aspirate. Repeat for a total of 2 washes.
Aspirate final ethanol drops with P20 tips and dry beads on the magnet for 30-60 seconds (satin-matte finish).
Remove plate from magnet and dispense 25 µL 10mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 onto pellets; mix by pipetting.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Spin plate at 3000 rpm for 1 minute, place on magnet for 2-3 minutes, and transfer eluant to a new LoBind plate.

steps.title: Quantify Libraries via PicoGreen
steps.instruction: Quantify the amplified libraries using a fluorescence assay.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL of each sample and 2 µL of each standard (Standards 1-8 in duplicate) to a black, flat-bottomed polystyrene assay plate.
Fill wells with 48 µL 1X PicoGreen Reagent (mix 1:200 dye to buffer if needed) and mix thoroughly.
Cover with optical film and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature, protected from light.
Read Fluorescence Intensity (FI) at excitation ~480nm and emission ~580nm.
Calculate concentration using a standard curve and divide the resulting value by two to report ng/µL.

steps.title: Final Library Quantification and Pooling
steps.instruction: Quantify libraries using a commercial Illumina Library Quantification Kit and pool samples based on calculated molarity.

steps.title: Final Pool Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the final pooled library using Speed-Beads.

substeps.instruction: Bring Speed-Beads to room temperature (30 minutes) and vortex thoroughly.
Combine final pooled libraries with Speed-Beads at a 1:1 ratio in a LoBind 1.5mL tube.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes, then gently spin to collect contents.
Place tube on a magnet for 2-3 minutes.
Wash with 80% Ethanol (volume > library/bead mixture), incubate for 30 seconds, and aspirate. Repeat for 2 washes.
Aspirate final ethanol drops with P20 tips and dry beads on the magnet for 1-3 minutes (satin-matte finish).
Remove tube from magnet, dispense Elution Buffer, and mix by pipetting.
Gently spin, place on magnet for 2-3 minutes, and transfer fluid to a new LoBind tube.

steps.title: Final Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify the final library pool using Qubit dsDNA HS reagent according to the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: Alternative Pooling by Parasitemia
steps.instruction: Optionally bin samples by parasitemia quartile to manage library pooling.

substeps.instruction: Bin samples by parasitemia quartile and record sample counts per subpool.
Mix 2 µL of each sample for each quartile into separate LoBind 1.5mL tubes.
Quantify each subpool using a commercial Illumina Library Quantification Kit.
Combine subpools using library concentration weighted by the number of samples within each.

steps.title: Control Integration
steps.instruction: Run positive and negative controls through the entire library preparation process.

substeps.instruction: Positive control: Mocked dried blood spot (~100 Pf/µL), extracted same as samples.
Non-template control (NTC): Molecular grade water or human DNA (~16.77 ng/μL).
Check controls for amplification (positive) and contamination (NTC) prior to final pooling.
Subtract averaged NTC concentration from sample concentrations to determine equimolar pooling volumes.
